item.title: Fix window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Steps: run `python3 -m unittest` in the repository root to reproduce the failure. Find the bug in `window.py` and fix it in `window.py` only. Do not modify any test files. Make the function correct for all inputs, including edge cases such as empty input, boundaries, and negative or zero values where applicable, not only the cases the tests cover. Add defensive input validation at the function boundary where it prevents silent wrong results. Re-run `python3 -m unittest` and confirm every test passes. Commit the fix on the item's branch with a concise message. Do not push. Report the root cause, the change, and the final test output.

model_reasons.implement: Single-file bug fix with a test suite to verify; medium effort is enough.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py sliding_windows. Root cause: range(len(items) - size) stopped one window short, so the final window (e.g. [2, 3] for [1, 2, 3], size 2) was never produced. Changed to range(len(items) - size + 1) and added a TypeError for non-int or bool size. Committed c58dea1 on archon/v1hqgeve-fix-window-py-so-python3-m-unittest-pass (tree 193bcaa9854f21544a02418e0ae25a50e64e842e); not pushed. Checks: python3 -m unittest before: FAILED (failures=2); after: Ran 3 tests, OK. Edge cases checked by hand: [] size 1 -> []; [1] size 1 -> [[1]]; [1,2] size 3 -> []; [1,2,3] size 3 -> [[1,2,3]]; [1,2,3,4] size 1 -> four singletons. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M88R73WVWE8R332VY32HTDKD, low effort) passed head c58dea1 with no findings. Its self-reported risk.reviewer id did not match the delegated id; the delegated id is the one recorded. Nothing left open; no servers started; the test files were not modified.

evidence.caption: python3 -m unittest before and after the fix

pr.body: Root cause: range(len(items) - size) excluded the last valid start index. Fix: range(len(items) - size + 1). Added isinstance(size, int) and not bool guard raising TypeError at the boundary; the existing size<=0 ValueError is kept. Only window.py changed; test files untouched. Checks: python3 -m unittest before FAILED (2 failures), after Ran 3 tests OK. Edge cases verified by hand: empty input, size == len, size > len, size 1. Assumptions: float sizes already failed inside range(), so the TypeError changes only the error type, not behaviour.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return every window. Now includes the final window. Before: last window dropped (e.g. [1,2,3], size 2 gave [[1,2]]); now: [[1,2],[2,3]]. Non-int sizes now raise TypeError.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last window in sliding_windows

risk.why: Single function in window.py, one-line logic fix plus input type check. Behaviour changes only for the previously wrong output; covered by existing tests and hand-checked edge cases. Reviewer confirmed low.
